thread:
devin-recruiter: Heads up 3: candidate (Ahmed R) renewing H4 EAD in UAE. Start date June 1. He asked if we can do a remote-but-onboarded start while EAD pending.

marco-peopleops: Reminder - EAD pending means no work authorization in US. They can only do unpaid onboarding or training. If they will be physically outside US, we need EOR or contractor.

anya-legal: Also check H4 status rules for UAE consulate. For EAD renewals, we usually avoid having them work until they have active EAD card. If they plan to work remotely from UAE, check local tax/employment law; recommend EOR.

olga-payroll: If EOR, benefits and W-2 wait until conversion. Budget constraint: we have $1k pre-approval for EOR bridging per hire.

devin-recruiter: Candidate prefers unpaid onboarding and starting W-2 once EAD arrives. Is it okay to do "voluntary training"?

anya-legal: Voluntary training is OK if truly unpaid and no direction that constitutes "work". Keep it to orientation, security training, reading docs. No billable tasks. Document candidate consent.

people-ops-bot: FYI: policy doc link: https://internal.redwood/hr/immigration/eor-policy

marco-peopleops: Action: ask candidate to sign consent confirming voluntary unpaid onboarding. Capture in hiring ticket.

devin-recruiter: Will do. Thanks.

anya-legal: Also logging note: do not complete I-9 or payroll setup until EAD card arrives.

olga-payroll: Noted.

marco-peopleops: Closing: candidate to start unpaid orientation May 25; W-2 start pending EAD activation.
